scenario: Returning a faulty item at a shop

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.
dialogue.translation: Salaam, daraama naa teelu bi ci ñi, waaye du amul liggéey.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?
dialogue.translation: Jëkkërëjëf ci ndax. Naka waxtu la daraama?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Only two days ago. I want a new one, if possible.
dialogue.translation: Yàppal ñett féer ci ndax. Dama bëggee yu bees, su ma waxal.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Take this form and fill it out. After that, I can give you a replacement.
dialogue.translation: Dafa dox. Jëkkëlu baat bii, ndaxte naa ko wax. Ba ci kanam, maa ngi ko waxal.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Jëëref. Waaye dama ko def ci teelu bi ñu amul liggéey, ndaxte maa ngi bëggee yu bees?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Dafa dox. Su maa ngi bëgg ci yàpp, jàppale ma.

dialogue.translation: Waaw, dama laa. Maa ngi yëppal ci télefon ci suuf.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great. Can I have your name for the reservation?
dialogue.translation: Jërejëf. Laa ma lim ak sa lim ci taabal?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, it's under the name García.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, dama laa ci lim García.

scenario: Talking about your hometown to a visitor

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Welcome to my hometown! It's a small place, but I love it.
dialogue.translation: ¡Dañeel ci toogal ma! Dafa doom bi, waaye ma dee ko ci jamm.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks! Where do you live exactly?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I live near the old church. It's very beautiful.
dialogue.translation: Laa toog ci mbir ak jëkkër gi toog. Dafa doom bi, dafa maas.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, nice! Is there a market every day?
dialogue.translation: Oh, maas! Dafa doom ci mbir ak jëfandikkat?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, and I walk there every morning to buy fresh things.
dialogue.translation: Waaye, laa jëkk ci mbir ak jëfandikkat ci suba, ndax mu nekk ci jamm.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. Then we can go together tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Dafa doom bi, maas. Waaye, lan laa dee ko ci mbir ak jëfandikkat ci suba?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Lan laa soo ñaan ci ndoof?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Dama di ceebu jën, waaye ma soo ñun ndax bu baaxul tey.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Danga ñun jën te ndiyax ci teew. Li laa soo ñaan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Li laa soo ñaan. Waaye ma joxe soo ñun ndax bu jàll.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Ndax laa soo def ci ndiyax ñun ceeb?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, li laa soo ñaan. Ndax laa soo ñaan ndax, te ma laa soo jëfandikoo ook.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Yëppalal ma ndigël? Mën naa liggéey ci ordinatëram, waxtaan panetalam dafa xonq.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Dafa dox. Maangi def. Tëgg nga bëtt jotna?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, maangi tëgg. Waaye liggéeyul. Defarul ma nekk.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Dëgg ci weer. Ñunga liggéey ci ay xam-xam.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Dafa dox, maangi ñett. Waaye ndax laa bëgg, maangi bëgg li ngay.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Dafa dox. Maangi def bëtt ci mbirum. Ah, laa! Liggéey na!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Salaam, ma ngi bëgg alquilar apartamento. Dafa disponible ci biir?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, dafa disponible. Alquiler bi ñu ko jëf 800 dollar ci biir.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Njariñ bi la ko jëf ci ndox ak mbir?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Déedéet, dafa jëf ndox ak mbir. Mbiri bi lañu ko jëf ci saare.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Ba noppi ci ñu ko jëf ci saare? Dafa ci mbir yu supermarket?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Da fa ci saare ñett, ak dafa ci mbir yu supermarket yu ñett. Baax naa ci ñu ko jëf ci suba.

key_phrases.translation: Njariñ bi la ko jëf ci...?
